Bavarian Nordic donates 75,000 doses of MVA-BN® and will also supply 150,000 doses to new global mpox vaccine emergency stockpile.
Building emergency reserves is an important milestone in global mpox preparedness, helping ensure timely and equitable access to vaccines.
This new initiative reflects Bavarian Nordic’s longstanding role as a trusted partner in global health security and its mission to protect people and communities, and save lives, through vaccines.
